name: quay-dev
description: DOGFOOD marketplace for THIS repository's working tree: register <repo>/plugin at USER scope (machine-specific path, never committed) and enable quay@quay-dev in the repo's .claude/settings.json. The name is deliberately NOT `quay`: a marketplace name is ONE machine-wide slot, and a directory marketplace loads its plugin in place, so a `quay` slot pointing here would make every project on the machine run this dev tree. Published copies (dist-plugin via plugin/scripts/publish-dist-branch.sh, the npm tarball via packages/quay/scripts/package.sh) are stamped back to the release channel's name by scripts/stamp-marketplace-name.mjs.

plugins.name: quay
plugins.description: quay: a provider-agnostic task board. Bundles the quay MCP server, quay-directive skill, quay-loop-driver skill, and author/execute authoring skills.
